description_for_human: Agent-native geopolitical risk simulation. Monte Carlo war-gaming, nuclear deterrence, chokepoint analysis.
description_for_model: Use GeoSim to run geopolitical Monte Carlo simulations and query world state. Call /api/scenarios to list built-in scenarios (Taiwan Strait Blockade 2026, Russia-EU Gas Cutoff, Hormuz Closure Crisis, Nuclear Standoff Deterrence, EU-China Decoupling, Multi-Front Crisis, Arctic LNG Race 2030, Baseline Stability 2030). Call /api/monte-carlo with {scenario, n, horizon_days} for probability distributions and a composite risk score. Call /api/nl with free-text user intent to let the server parse it into a scenario. All endpoints are public, no auth, JSON only.
